app.notes:
The version number now shows on Home; tap it to see what changed and check for updates
The guide melody is one saved level: what you set stays for every song, and Guide on comes back to that level
Turning the phone no longer changes the background: the same video or photo carries on, and so do the song's colours and anything you had open
The camera key on the keypad now opens Stage Background: choose videos and their folder, photos, the camera, or theme art, and add your own from the gallery
The camera can be flipped, shown whole, and dimmed
The phone remote has a volume slider with the level and mute, the stage shows the new volume, and a phone used as the remote changes it with its own volume buttons
The BGV key on the phone remote opens the same Stage Background choices
New Interlude Banner settings: your own words, position, size, colour, font and look, with the time left and the next line
The live preview now shows what the stage really shows: the background, chords, pitch guide, title card, banner, prompt and greeting
Custom Theme's preview shows the accents, menu font and number pad photo, and says when a Lyrics setting is overriding the theme
A song now pauses for a phone call or another app's music
Reserved songs can come back after a crash or a restart
Long lyric lines break onto two rows instead of running off the screen, and the song's title stays readable on light themes
New play modes: repeat this song, repeat all and shuffle; reserved songs can be moved up and cleared
Lyrics can sit at the top, middle or bottom, and the song's title can be hidden
New settings for what opens first, where to go after the last song, and the singing screen's rotation
When there's no score, the screen now says why, and Settings has Test the Microphone, which can also choose a USB microphone
Recordings keep their score, and Battle mode shows whose turn it is in that singer's colour
Search now finds songs by a line of their lyrics too, by itself, after the title matches; songs can also be sorted by newest, most sung, size or type
Lyrics can come from a .txt file beside a song or from an MP3's own tags
Lyrics fitted to a MIDI now light up word by word, and ones that don't quite fit open as a best guess to check
Playlists can be renamed, reordered and shuffled; singers can be renamed and removed, and each has their own best score and song count
Only the host can send songs unless you open it up, and the QR on Send Songs includes the host code
The phone remote can pause and skip the music between songs, and the Party page counts connected phones
The small window has pause and next buttons
New Getting Started guide, and a letter keyboard in search for TV remotes
Updating the song list no longer shows the Loading screen, a background video that can't play is skipped, and a device on the setup screen can now update itself
Backups keep your own songs' numbers and no longer copy this device's join code
